name: waves-site
description: Deploy root. Exists so Vercel installs what the api/ functions import — the site itself is static and has no build step.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const f=require('fs');const s='node_modules/harfbuzzjs/hb.wasm',d='node_modules/@vercel/og/dist/hb.wasm';if(f.existsSync(s)&&!f.existsSync(d)){f.copyFileSync(s,d);console.log('og: copied hb.wasm into @vercel/og/dist')}}catch(e){console.log('og postinstall skipped:',e.message)}"
